title: 第5章 条件第6章 大功告成
content_zh:
第5章条件
“可以，但惹到我的人，他们的灵魂属于我，还有，如果正好碰到灵魂出现，我有资格截取，当然，少量。”
王南轩想了想，点头答应，这个条件问题不大，因为这是漫威世界，想让人类签订灵魂契约，不难。
浩克和憎恶大战，大楼马上倒塌，让你签订契约，用死后的灵魂换取逃过一劫，你签不签？
齐塔瑞人进攻纽約，整个城市即将毁于一旦，你签不签？
“好。”
古一没有反对，她抬起手，金色光线在空中交织出一张契约：“如果你违背契约，你的小地狱将崩塌。”
“至尊法师，只有这两个条件？”
王南轩有些狐疑，这两个条件宽松的仿佛他是古一的私生子，至尊法师是不是看到了什么？又或者，她出现了什么问题？
古一笑道：“你嫌少的话，我可以多加几条，我不介意。”
王南轩说道：“加上一条，签订契约后，如果你对我出手，又或者暗中算计我，那这份契约将无效。”
古一看了王南轩一眼，说道：“可以。”
接着，王南轩和古一同时在契约上按下手印，契约亮起耀眼的金光，随即一分为二，分别飞入王南轩和古一的体内。
契约，正式成立！
王南轩松了一口气，大功告成，这时，古一说道：“你的地狱是新生的，将来它会发展成什么样，由你自己决定。”
王南轩有点惊讶：“我自己决定？”
“对，大多数地狱都充满混乱，邪恶，杀戮，但那不意味着所有地狱都是那样，地狱是宇宙不可或缺的一部分，它拥有自身的职责。”
古一点了点头，她说道：“你要做的第一步，是先给自己，给地狱起个名号，新生的地狱领主。”
王南轩笑了笑，说道：“不急，暂时先叫做重生地狱，等将来，它会有一个更适合的名字。”
……

古一和王南轩是用意识在交流，他们谈了大半天，现实世界才过去一秒，墨菲斯托见时间停止，哈哈大笑：
“小子，想抢我的东西，做梦，你马上就会知道古一那老女人有多恐怖，这就是跟我作对的下场。”
墨菲斯托话音刚落，周围时间恢复，王南轩彻底构建小地狱，他与本体无障碍连接，本体随时能将力量传到他身上，他也随时能将东西传回重生地狱。
神清气爽的王南轩一脸不解地问道：“下场？老墨，什么下场？我怎么什么都没看到？”
墨菲斯托傻眼，他怒吼道：“古一，你为什么不阻止他？”
“你在教我做事？”
古一冷漠的声音从天上传下来，接着，她朝卡西利亚斯说道：“不用再理会这件事，将恶灵骑士带回卡玛泰姬。”
“是，老师。”
卡西利亚斯虽然很不解，但还是恭敬的点头，接着，他将魔法鞭用力甩向恶灵骑士。
强尼想要躲避，身上的火焰突然变得不受控制，这让他无法移动，被魔法鞭捆了个正着。
content_en:
Chapter 5 Conditions
"Yes, but the souls of those who offend me belong to me. Also, if the soul happens to appear, I am qualified to intercept it, of course, in a small amount."
Wang Nanxuan thought for a while and nodded in agreement. This condition was not a big problem because this was the Marvel world and it was not difficult to get humans to sign a soul contract.
Hulk and Abomination fight, and the building will collapse soon. You are asked to sign a contract, and you will use your soul after death in exchange for escaping. Will you sign it?
The Chitauri are attacking New York and the entire city is about to be destroyed. Will you sign or not?
"Okay."
Gu Yi did not object. She raised her hand, and golden light intertwined a contract in the air: "If you violate the contract, your little hell will collapse."
"Supreme Mage, these are the only two conditions?"
Wang Nanxuan was a little suspicious. These two conditions were so relaxed as if he was Gu Yi's illegitimate son. Did the Supreme Mage see something? Or, what's wrong with her?
Gu Yi smiled and said: "If you think it's too little, I can add a few more, I don't mind."
Wang Nanxuan said: "Add one more thing. After signing the contract, if you take action against me or plot against me secretly, then the contract will be invalid."
Gu Yi glanced at Wang Nanxuan and said, "Okay."
Then, Wang Nanxuan and Gu Yi pressed their fingerprints on the contract at the same time. The contract lit up with a dazzling golden light, then split into two and flew into Wang Nanxuan and Gu Yi's bodies respectively.
The contract is officially established!
Wang Nanxuan breathed a sigh of relief and it was done. At this time, Gu Yi said: "Your hell is new. What it will develop into in the future is up to you."
Wang Nanxuan was a little surprised: "I decide on my own?"
"Yes, most hells are full of chaos, evil, and killing, but that doesn't mean all hells are like that. Hell is an integral part of the universe, and it has its own responsibilities."
Gu nodded and said, "The first step you have to do is to give yourself a name for hell, the new lord of hell."
Wang Nanxuan smiled and said: "No rush, let's call it Rebirth Hell for now. In the future, it will have a more suitable name."
…
Ancient Yi and Wang Nanxuan communicated with their consciousness. They talked for a long time, and only one second passed in the real world. Mephisto saw that time stopped and laughed:
"Boy, if you want to steal my things, if you have a dream, you will soon know how scary that old woman Gu Yi is. This is the consequence of opposing me."
As soon as Mephisto finished speaking, the surrounding time was restored. Wang Nanxuan completely constructed a small hell. He was connected to the main body without any obstacles. The main body could transfer power to him at any time, and he could also transfer things back to the rebirth hell at any time.
The refreshed Wang Nanxuan asked with a puzzled look on his face: "What's the end? Lao Mo, what's the end? Why didn't I see anything?"
Mephisto was dumbfounded and roared: "Ancient One, why didn't you stop him?"
"Are you teaching me how to do something?"
Ancient One's cold voice came down from the sky, and then she said to Casillas: "Don't pay attention to this matter anymore, bring the Ghost Rider back to Kama Taj."
"Yes, teacher."
Although Casillas was puzzled, he still nodded respectfully, and then he swung the magic whip hard at the Ghost Rider.
Johnny wanted to dodge, but the flames on his body suddenly became uncontrollable, which made him unable to move and was tied up by the magic whip.
